title: Inukshuk Broadcasting System Grand Opening (IBC 00677IQ, Igloolik)
license: no reuse licence; IBC item page carries only the access note: made available on the Internet for your enjoyment through funding provided by the Government of Canada and the Government of Nunavut
notes: Canada (Nunavut/NWT), Inuktut, no subtitles. Igloolik 1980, the Anik B satellite switched on: a float helicopter hovering over the sea, an IBC studio speaker cutting to a man held on a monitor under an Inuktut chyron (the teleconference), the white earth-station dome on the tundra, the racks of broadcast gear brought north, a woman at the console, and games in the community gym. Fetched from the page's SD source https://s3.amazonaws.com/isuma.video.mp4_sd/00677iqinuk-80-76-inuk_inukshuk_grand_opening.mp4.mp4 (yt-dlp cannot read isuma.tv item pages).
